pitfalls: find --role edit for 'Search' returns empty: YouTube's search box is an AXComboBox. Fix: use --role combobox (only needed as a fallback).
find --title Search without a role may match the Chrome omnibox. Fix: always give a role plus title 'Search'.

'Clear search query' is listed FIRST, right before the real 'Search' button, and pressing it erases the query. --expect-description Search is only a substring check and passes for it too. Fix: pick the button whose title is exactly 'Search'; never first or by index.
'Search with your voice' and 'Report search predictions' also match title Search. Ignore them.
Find output in logs can be cut off; the needed 'Search' button appears before the cut. If an element seems missing, raise --limit.
Results show truncated="true" even when fine. Raise --limit or narrow --title only if no AXLink with id=video-title appears.
Result may be a playlist/radio URL (list=RD…&start_radio=1). It still plays the song, so accept it.
The link title includes the duration; use the description (clean title, or a prefix) for --expect-description.
Pressing the result too early fails because results haven't rendered. Wait ~2500 ms after submit.
Always pass --expect-description so a wrong element fails fast.

OVER-VERIFICATION (recurred in Halo AND Viva La Vida: after the first Pause (k) hit and done, the run waited 2000 ms, re-found Pause, searched Skip, pressed 'Skip navigation' and then the ad Skip button, ~10 wasted actions). Fix: the first Pause (k) hit is final; done ends the task. Never continue after done, never re-verify, never look for Skip when Pause (k) exists. The pause path changing between finds (…0.4 -> …0.5) is normal and NOT a failure signal.
A 'Skip' button (skip-button:6s) can be present in the tree at the same time as Pause (k); its existence does not mean playback is blocked. Only consider it if Pause (k) is missing.
Title 'Skip' also matches 'Skip navigation' (masthead, offscreen y<0, path ...0.3.0). Pressing it is a no-op and is wrong. Select by id prefix skip-button.
Do not query the Seek slider (disabled and stale) or search for timestamp text (not exposed as AXStaticText).
Don't reuse paths between runs; layout and tabs change them. The pause button path shifts within a run, so re-find if needed.

Box derivation rule: box = button path minus trailing '.1' plus '.0.0.0'. Do not confuse with the Clear search query button path (…4.0.0.1), which sits next to the box (…4.0.0.0). Confirmed with Halo and Viva La Vida.
Non-ASCII artist names (Beyoncé) pass through set-value fine; for find --title use a plain ASCII word of the song title (Halo, Viva), not the accented name.

steps: Precondition: Chrome open on any youtube.com page with masthead search visible; target the Chrome window via blindly4. Existing query is fine because set-value overwrites it.

Step 1 (find button): find --role button --title Search --depth 40 --limit 8 --format xml. Pick the AXButton whose title is EXACTLY 'Search' (path ends ...4.0.1, actions AXPress, frame ≈1153,131,80x50) and record it as SEARCH_BUTTON. Never pick 'Clear search query' (listed first, path ends ...4.0.0.1), 'Search with your voice' or 'Report search predictions'.

Step 2 (derive box, no find): SEARCH_BOX = SEARCH_BUTTON minus trailing '.1' plus '.0.0.0' (…4.0.1 -> …4.0.0.0). Held in 9 runs. Only if step 3 fails, run find --role combobox --title Search --depth 40 --limit 4 --format xml and use the single AXComboBox.
Step 3 (type): set-value --path SEARCH_BOX --value "<artist song>" --expect-description Search. Expect ok:true.
Step 4 (submit): press --path SEARCH_BUTTON --expect-description Search. Expect ok:true.
Step 5: wait 2500 ms for results to render.

Step 6 (find result): find --role link --title "<one distinctive ASCII word of the song title>" --depth 40 --limit 6 --format xml. Take the first AXLink with id="video-title" and value starting https://www.youtube.com/watch (list=RD… radio URLs are fine). Record RESULT_PATH and its description. truncated="true" is normal. Top result path has been 0.1.0.0.1.1.0.1.0.0.5.3.1.0.0 for the last two runs.
Step 7 (play): press --path RESULT_PATH --expect-description "<description or leading prefix, e.g. 'Coldplay - Viva La Vida (Official Video)'>". Expect ok:true.

Step 9 (verify ONCE, then STOP): find --role button --title Pause --depth 40 --limit 3 --format xml. One AXButton 'Pause (k)' = success: call done IMMEDIATELY and end the task. Do NOT wait, re-find Pause, search for Skip, or press anything afterwards (the Viva La Vida run wasted ~10 extra actions after the first Pause hit, including pressing 'Skip navigation'). If only 'Play (k)' appears, press it and re-verify once. If neither appears, wait 3000 ms (ad) and retry once. Only if Pause is still absent and an ad is suspected, find --role button --title Skip --limit 4 and press the button whose id starts with 'skip-button'.

Total: 6 tool calls + 2 waits (find button, set-value, press, find result, press, verify), then done. Confirmed on 8 songs (Bohemian Rhapsody, Take On Me, Africa, Billie Jean, Happy, Uptown Funk, Halo, Viva La Vida). Target for next song: exactly these 8 actions; nothing after the first Pause (k) hit.
